description: Elections Commision - Declare that Mr. K. V. Shantha Bandara as a Member of the Eight Parliament
reasoning: This gazette notification specifically addresses the filling of a parliamentary vacancy under the Parliamentary Elections Act. It involves the electoral process, including the declaration of a vacancy due to resignation, the nomination process by a political party, and the official declaration of a new Member of Parliament by the Election Commission. This content falls squarely under electoral processes and related matters, making it an Elections Gazette.
